claims.claim: rumqttc v0.25.1 (latest release, tagged 21 Nov) is a patch release focused on fixing the WebSocket build breakage and dependency updates, with no re-subscription or session-handling changes.
claims.stance_target: Upgrading rumqttc 0.24.0 to 0.25.x would not by itself deliver automatic re-subscription after reconnect
claims.scope_conditions: rumqttc releases 0.24.0 through 0.25.1; bytebeamio/rumqtt GitHub releases page
claims.quoted_support: This patch release focuses on fixing the broken WebSocket feature and includes dependency updates. ... Fixed: Build failure when compiling with the websocket feature enabled (#999) ... Added: New use-rustls-no-provider feature for more flexible TLS configuration (#988)

claims.claim: rumqttc v0.25.0 added MQTT v5 session_expiry_interval support, v5 Auth packet support, public DisconnectProperties, TCP no_delay, set_client_id in MqttOptions, and fixed subscribe_many EmptySubscription errors and poll() event ordering — but no auto re-subscribe feature.
claims.stance_target: 0.25.x improves v5 session handling but still does not implement automatic re-subscription of topics after reconnect
claims.quoted_support: Enhanced MQTT v5 Support — Session Management: Added support for session_expiry_interval in MQTT v5 connections, giving you better control over session persistence ... Subscribe Many Fix: Resolved critical issue where subscribe_many always caused EmptySubscription errors ... Improved event ordering in poll() method for more predictable behavior

claims.claim: rumqttc v0.24.0 was released 21 May by de-sh and its headline features were EventLoop::clean for graceful shutdown, TLS key-format expansion (removal of the Key enum), and a websocket request modifier — plus a change where set_clean_session now panics on empty client_id.
claims.stance_target: The pinned 0.24.0 release is a v3.1.1-default client whose session semantics rely on clean_session and it contains no re-subscription machinery
claims.quoted_support: MqttOptions::new now accepts empty client_id and MqttOptions::set_clean_session panics if client_id is empty and clean_session flag is set to false. ... Expose EventLoop::clean to allow triggering shutdown and subsequent storage of pending requests by @de-sh in #741

claims.claim: The rumqtt release cadence from 0.23.0 through 0.25.1 spans roughly 12 months with active maintenance: 0.23.0 (10 Oct), 0.24.0 (21 May), 0.25.0 (09 Sep), 0.25.1 (21 Nov), interleaved with rumqttd releases 0.18.0-0.20.0.
claims.stance_target: rumqttc is an actively maintained dependency, not abandoned
claims.quoted_support: rumqttc 0.22.0 ... rumqttc 0.23.0 ... rumqttc-0.24.0 ... rumqttc-0.25.0 ... rumqttc-0.25.1 Latest

claims.claim: No rumqttc release note between 0.22.0 and 0.25.1 mentions automatic re-subscription, Event::Reconnect, or merging PR #1052; the releases page's latest entry (0.25.1) predates/postdates the PR without including it.
claims.stance_target: PR #1052 (Event::Reconnect for re-subscription signal) is NOT in any released rumqttc version — consumers must implement re-subscribe logic themselves
claims.quoted_support: rumqttc-0.25.1 Latest ... rumqttc-0.25.0 ... rumqttc-0.24.0 ... rumqttc 0.23.0 ... rumqttc 0.22.0 — no release note text mentions resubscribe, re-subscription, Event::Reconnect, or #1052
